name: ferrite-console
description: Ferrite Console: live view, remote keys and (next) channel programming for Ferrite on the Radtel RT-950 Pro

scripts.dev: npm run wasm && npm run fonts && vite
scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run fonts && vite build
scripts.e2e: npm run wasm && npm run fonts && VITE_DEV_TOOLS=1 vite build && playwright test
scripts.build:dev: npm run wasm && npm run fonts && VITE_DEV_TOOLS=1 vite build
scripts.build:single: npm run wasm && npm run fonts && vite build --mode single
scripts.build:app: npm run wasm && npm run fonts && vite build --mode app
